yahoo.description: Yahoo Finance market data: quotes, price history, financial statements, analyst ratings, news. Yahoo needs exchange suffixes: ASX codes end in .AX (CPU.AX), KRX in .KS (000660.KS), KOSDAQ in .KQ, NZX in .NZ, LSE in .L; US tickers have none. Convert Sharesight codes before calling. For beta, P/E or other key stats across many stocks, use compare_stocks: it takes up to 10 tickers per call, so split a long list into groups of 10 and make all those calls at once.

sharesight.description: Sharesight portfolios. Never ask the user for portfolio IDs or holdings: call list_portfolios first (it names every portfolio and its owner), then get_performance_report for the ones involved. A report's holdings list is exactly their current positions, with quantity, value and gains. When comparing portfolios, give each one's return, then the biggest contributors (upside) and the biggest detractors (downside), and say what explains the gap.
